description: Adds footage to the user's Huasheng library, or organises what is already there. add takes files on this machine, public URLs and ids alike. Huasheng reads a newly added video before it can pick it, which costs credits by the second; the result says how many. Images are free and usable at once. action=price answers "how much would this cost" without adding anything. Use huasheng_list_materials to inspect the library. Permanent deletion uses huasheng_delete_materials so the host can show the right warning.

action.description: Library operation. price = what add would cost, without adding anything

client_action_id.description: MCP App only: submission id; reuse for the same click. Models omit.

folder_id.description: Folder to list, rename, or move into; 0 is top level

material.description: For add: what to add, each one a file on this machine, a public http(s) URL, or the id of something the user sent while editing (huasheng_list_materials with list="uploads" shows those)

ui_lang.description: MCP App only: follow-up language. Models omit.

url.description: Compatibility only. Use material for new calls — one public http(s) URL

name: huasheng_manage_materials
title: Add or organise footage
